cards.card_text: Where do they go to gather stubble for straw?
cards.verse_text: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
cards.snippet: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

cards.card_text: God overthrew His adversaries by His great majesty, and His burning wrath consumed them like stubble.
cards.verse_text: You unleashed Your burning wrath; it consumed them like stubble.
cards.snippet: You unleashed Your burning wrath; it consumed them like stubble.

cards.card_text: Then He says, "You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble." Friend, that's me mixing and stamping a giant batch for an HOUR, opening the oven, and finding nothing but crumbs.
cards.verse_text: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble.
cards.snippet: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble.

cards.verse_text: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner have their stems taken root in the ground, than He blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble.
cards.snippet: …on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble.

cards.verse_text: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up.
cards.snippet: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up.

cards.card_text: They look like horses, gallop like swift steeds, and bound over the mountaintops with a sound like chariots, like crackling fire eating up stubble.
cards.verse_text: With a sound like that of chariots they bound over the mountaintops, like the crackling of fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army deployed for battle.
cards.snippet: …chariots they bound over the mountaintops, like the crackling of fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army deployed for battle.

cards.verse_text: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble—Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it.
cards.snippet: …of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble—Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it.

cards.card_text: Nahum adds one more picture: being consumed like stubble that is fully ___.
cards.verse_text: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard—like stubble that is fully dry.
cards.snippet: …entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard—like stubble that is fully dry.

cards.card_text: The LORD says that on that burning day, some will be like stubble set ablaze.
cards.verse_text: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts.
